title: Smoothing splines with some discontinuities
abstract: arXiv:2610.33137v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We generalize cubic smoothing splines to signals with a finite number of discontinuities at unknown positions. Rather than changing the roughness penalty, we deform the domain over which it is computed: every interval between consecutive observations can be stretched by a non-negative warp, subject to a total budget, and the optimizer spends the budget only where a jump makes stretching cheaper than bending. The estimator inherits the state-space form of smoothing splines, so it can be fitted by maximum likelihood with the Kalman filter, and it also admits a fast alternating algorithm that solves a banded linear system and takes a projected-gradient step on the warps. The budget is selected by an extended Bayesian information criterion whose constant is calibrated by simulation. In a Monte Carlo comparison the new estimators reconstruct a piecewise-smooth signal more accurately than the cubic smoothing spline with discontinuities of St

translated_title: 具有若干不连续点的平滑样条
translated_abstract: 我们将三次平滑样条推广到在未知位置存在有限个不连续点的信号。我们并未改变粗糙度惩罚，而是对计算该惩罚的定义域进行变形：相邻观测之间的每个区间都可以被一个非负的形变量拉伸，但需满足总预算约束，优化器只会在跳跃处（即拉伸比弯曲更划算的地方）花费这一预算。该估计量继承了平滑样条的状态空间形式，因此可以通过卡尔曼滤波用极大似然方法进行拟合；此外还存在一种快速交替算法，每次迭代求解一个带状线性系统，并在形变量上执行一步投影梯度。总预算由扩展的贝叶斯信息准则选取，其常数通过模拟进行校准。在蒙特卡洛比较中，新估计量比分段不连续三次平滑样条（原文此处截断）更准确地重构了分片平滑信号。
tldr: 提出一种通过在总预算约束下对定义域施加非负形变（区间拉伸）来刻画未知位置不连续点的新平滑样条方法，可用卡尔曼滤波极大似然拟合，并在重构分片平滑信号上比现有方法更准确。
